strings.en: Just do it like in training...!
I have to assess the situation calmly...!
I have to do this right...!
Wide field of view, stay calm...!
They have a Raig-Geios too.../　I can't lose!
If the machines are the same,/　the deciding factor is the pilot's skill...!
Al-Van's Raftclans.../　I have to be careful!
A black Raftclans... I can't let my guard down!
Give up on the throne, Gu-Landon!
Are they really Gaia Savers remnants...?!
The Gestorben carried off just now/　was Lieutenant Serena's... No way...!
You're the ones who got Lieutenant Albada/　and Lieutenant Serena...! Unforgivable!
They're the ones who got Team Jelba...!/　Lieutenant Albada and Lieutenant Serena!
I won't let you Golaikunru do as you please!
Seems you've no intention of heeding our warning...!
Iradoya.../　I mustn't get caught up in her pace...!
So you don't care about the Privy Council's decision...!
The Baran-Schneil's firepower and range/　must never be underestimated...!
Gomoudokka... there's no data on him...
His name isn't on Golaikunru's/　list of key figures...!
I can't let Reggiane's momentum/　push me back...!
I can't let Golaikunru/　have technology like that!
That monster is a Dark Brain remnant...!
Where are they teleporting the Kaana Type...?
I have to record data on Debudedabide...!
Even Debudedabide's sorcery must have patterns...!
That many machines,/　controlled all at once...!
I'd like to analyze the composition of its skin, but...!
If I think of it as a kind of bioweapon...!
There's a way to control the Lamaris...?!
There's a drive system inside the bones...?!
I have to destroy XN-L here...!/　For my country's sake too!
I have to slip through the barrage...!
I won't fall prey to the turrets!
I have to slip into its blind spot!
I know how to take down a Zeranio-class!
Aim for where the armor looks thinnest...!
I won't lose to an old model!
It's an old model, but in space combat,/　carelessness is fatal...!
Once I'm in close, it's mine!
I won't lose to some automated turret!
I can't underestimate/　the Rest Granche's mobility...!
The Rest Granche.../　a dangerous foe in space.
The Kareitsedo... trouble if it charges in.
That machine has surprising burst speed...!
Geios-Grude... I have to handle this carefully.
A troublesome machine to have as an enemy...!
If you keep fighting in the Earth Sphere,/　I will shoot you down!
The Privy Council hasn't authorized military action!
A leader unit. I have to be even more careful...!
I can't let my guard down against a leader unit...!
Even against a leader unit, I'll hold my own!
That machine isn't in the data...!
It could be a Golaikunru prototype, but...
I have to gather solid data/　on the Fury units...!
A machine built for ranged combat... if I get in close!
The Big Shoulder... trouble if it closes in.
Data on Thorn's machine is high priority...!
The Gasbra's acceleration/　is not to be underestimated...!
I have to bring back as much data as I can...
I can't leave the Lamaris unchecked!
I have to annihilate the Lamaris as fast as I can...!
I have to gather data while destroying them...!
The Kaana Type... I have to eliminate it fast!
If the Ida Type multiplies, it'll be a disaster!
I have to gather at least some data/　on the new model...!
That form... it looks more and more like the Einst...!
I have to pull it away from there fast...!
I won't give you a chance to escape!
I have a mission! I can't end here!
I-I can't die so easily...!/　That's right, just like Master...!
Purging damaged armor!/　That should make it easier to move...!
Spine damage?! The upper body won't turn right!
The waist joints are creaking...!/　I'll have to compensate with thrusters!
I-I have to stop Gomoudokka here...!
I c-can't let that technology reach the homeland...!
Y-You're not doing any more, Sokonko!
Ugh, I can't let Debudedabide's attacks confuse me...!
Skull Knight! I'm not going down yet!
I c-can't let XN-L do any more...!
Don't lose your nerve over this!
Ugh! Don't think I'm an easy opponent!
If I stop here, I'll get ganged up on!
Ugh! I have to respond more nimbly...!
Ngh! Pfeil III can still fight!
Ugh, the barrage is thick, as expected!
Ugh! The turrets react faster than I thought!
Ugh, and I have plenty of data on this machine...!
I have to update the Fury unit data...!
Ngh! If I take too long, the Lamaris will...!
Jua-Mu, as if I'd flinch at that!
Ngh! An opponent in a class of their own,/　even among the Fury...!
Ugh! You got me good, Sokonko!
I-I have to stop Golaikunru here...!
I can't let Gomoudokka do any more...!
Is that the Siebe Drive's true power...?!
No problems with the control systems.
A scratch on my armor won't make me flinch!
I have to handle this calmly...!
I need to move it better...!
Ugh, I have to adjust my motions...!
I don't think I'm moving by logic alone, but...!
Did I rely too much on predictions?
Pfeil III won't fall to this!
Was I careless against a battleship...?!
As long as I don't take a direct hit, I'll manage!
You moved just as I planned...!
I have to record Thorn's pattern just now...!
Ugh! That machine really is fast!
Al-Van... he's moving beyond my predictions!
Gomoudokka, trying to erase me is pointless!
Vort, that's not enough to stop me!
Ngh, its movements are hard to read!
I knew you'd come at me like that!
If I put Master's teachings to use...!
The Pfeil III can dodge this easily!
Even a super robot can handle this much!
It moves heavily compared to a PT, but...
Even the Raig-Geios can handle this much!
I can't take a direct hit from a battleship!
No matter how big your guns are!
It's one of my country's own machines./　I have plenty of data on it.
There's no way that machine will get me!
Seems you're not drawing out its full potential!
I'll pull this off, even against a Raftclans!
I can't waste time on Lamaris!
I can't let a Lamaris Ida latch onto me...!
I won't let Karo-Ran have his way!
I'll pull this off, even against the Zee-Gadin!
Iradoya, are you trying to gauge our strength...?
I'll be reporting your actions/　to the Privy Council!
I won't fall for that, Reggiane!
I'll slip through even the Floraga's barrage!
Your thinking is too simplistic, Debudedabide!
Its attack patterns are hard to predict, but...!
I won't let you have your way,/　Crystal Dragoon!
You won't hit me, Skull Knight!
I'll dodge the next one too!
If I go down here,/　I'll have no excuse to give Master.
That attack was easy to read!
Just as I thought, it's more agile/　than the normal type.
I can get good data from this machine.
Nice machine. I'll learn from this.
It reacts as fast as the Pfeil III.
The Raig-Geios isn't as sluggish/　as it looks.
If I can keep this up, even against a Kaana...!
I won't let Golaikunru have its way!
This is bad, at this rate...!
I won't let that opening slip by!
Dr. Shirakawa, leave the rest to me!
You might not need my help, Doctor,/　but...!
Lieutenant, leave the rest to me!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I'll take the hit with my machine!
I'll shoot them all down at once!
If I ram it with this huge body...!
Just like with the Gun Stabblader...!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
That was an amazing punch rush.
Sixteen hits a second is just the basics~!
The Gun Stabblader isn't/　just for shooting!
This is a motion pattern I made!
If I can get behind it!
I won't let you get away!
It's a primitive weapon, but it packs a punch!
